reviews.author: siveda mohan
reviews.text:
"Dear Dr. Aishwarya Parthasarathy Ma'am, I am writing this review to express my profound gratitude. Our counseling session with you on 6th June 2024 left us with a distinctly positive.Your are an amazing human and a great doctor. Your experience and knowledge is highly commendable.
From the initial consultation to the confirmation of a positive result in the Beta HCG report, your leadership and the entire team's flawless service were truly admirable and paiseworthy.
Throughout the three-month procedure, the care and attention demonstrated by the team were exceptional. The communication and clarity regarding the procedures were of the highest standard. Thank you for bringing joy to my family.We remain hopeful that we will be blessed with your divine support.

I am really blessed to have known you.Will highly recommend your place if anyone is looking to fulfill their dreams of entering parenthood."
